description: This file defines an Express router for handling real-time update endpoints related to a Tic-Tac-Toe backend. Currently, it contains a single placeholder GET endpoint at '/usage' that describes future plans for real-time updates via WebSocket or SSE, with instructions for polling certain endpoints for game state and history.

methods.name: router.get('/usage', auth(false), (req, res) => {...})
methods.description: Defines a GET endpoint '/usage' that responds with a message indicating that real-time updates are not yet implemented and describes planned future features.
